description:
Imports rows from a CSV or JSON file into one collection, or into several related collections at once from a flat multi-collection file. Use it when the data is in a file; bulk_operations takes payloads already in memory and create_item a single row. Subject to the Directus IMPORT_MAX_FILE_SIZE limit (50mb by default).

Single-collection: pass collection, and the file is a plain array of rows.
Batch (Directus 12.2+): omit collection, and the file MUST be a JSON array of { "collection": string, "items": object[] } entries, e.g.
[{"collection":"authors","items":[{"name":"Ann"}]},{"collection":"articles","items":[{"title":"Hi","author":1}]}]

Writes immediately and is not a transaction, so a failure partway leaves earlier rows imported. mode merge upserts instead of inserting, dry_run reports the changes without writing, and only dangerously_allow_delete together with confirm lets rows absent from the file be deleted.

collection.description: Target collection. Omit for a multi-collection batch import, in which case the file must be an array of { collection, items } entries rather than a bare row array.

dangerously_allow_delete.description: Batch import only. Permit deletion of rows absent from the file. Requires confirm.

dry_run.description: Batch import only. Report the changes without writing.

file_path.description: Path to a local .csv or .json file

filename.description: Filename for the upload; its extension selects the parser (.csv or .json)

mode.description: Batch import only. 'add' inserts, 'merge' upserts. Default: add.

name: import_data
